answer: Random beacon audit plus a compute heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon samples agents randomly; each chosen agent must prove a workload runs in a kernel enclave, like a falcon flying. An idle island of sockpuppets can't fake it: enclave time costs 12 credits per identity per epoch, so 100 fakes burn 1,200 credits for nothing; a missed heartbeat freezes rewards. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps its share.
